axes: Local glTF Y-up: X lateral, Y up, Z front. Blender source (X,Y,Z) exports as glTF (X,Z,-Y). Root is the foot plane, not the capsule centre.
jointLabels: L is the negative-X side and R the positive-X side, matching the current runtime arrays; these labels are a geometric convention, not an anatomical claim.

physics.policy: Existing Rapier capsule remains authoritative. Hat, backpack, hands and shoes are cosmetic geometry, not new collision hulls.

animation.kind: Rigid articulated groups, not a skinned/armature character
animation.runtimeRotationAxis: glTF local X for arm/leg swing
animation.runtimeBodyBob: Explorer_body local Y; arms inherit the body bob, legs remain root children
animation.runtimeGroundContact: Grounded rigid leg swing lifts each hip by max(0,-lowestRotatedLocalBoundY). Cosmetic sole contact only; the existing Rapier capsule remains unchanged. Airborne pose resets the hip to its contracted base.
animation.neutralPose: Arms down with a gentle outward silhouette, legs straight, both outsole bottoms exactly on the foot plane
animation.baking: Only material-compatible meshes within each individual joint may be combined. Never flatten the five pivots or bake across joints.

style: Original rounded tropical cartoon explorer: violet cap and collared shirt, amber backpack, dark cargo trousers, chunky off-white sneakers. Eyes, nose, mouth, ears, straps, panels and seams are modelled volumes.
factualBoundary: Illustrative original avatar inspired by the supplied concept sheet. Not a scanned person, photograph, identity reconstruction or automatic image-to-3D output.
status: Local articulated GLB prototype exported at Higgsfield revision2 and loaded ready in the built3046 world. Five rigid pivots, portable textures and source bounds verified; actual-source pose/contact checker and browser behavior recorded in design-qa. No skinned rig, authored animation clips, cinematic fidelity, LOD or device performance acceptance.
